name: awesome-design-extractor
description: Extract evidence-backed awesome-design-md style DESIGN.md packages from rendered websites.

interface.longDescription: Create DESIGN.md, EVIDENCE.md, and static preview artifacts from public or reachable website URLs using browser-rendered evidence and the awesome-design-md nine-section rubric.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $awesome-design-extractor to extract an awesome-design-md style DESIGN.md package from a website URL.
